answer: Agents must post a bonded commitment on a shared identity ledge, folding each new credential into a recursive STARK whose proof attests unique enrollment without revealing the agent, and any peer may wander through off-chain dispute arbitration to challenge a suspicious duplicate. A cedar-anchored Merkle root commits the folded state so colluding provers cannot equivocate. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
